title: Witness diagram Image 3: narrow kite-shaped outline with white lights and one red light
description: Simple digitally drawn witness diagram labeled "Image 3", showing a long, narrow, angled black outline tapering to a point, with four small white circles along it and one red dot near the wide end. It resembles the Image 2 formation on the previous page, at a different angle. The page also carries the signature block of the Director, AARO; marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 5.
